# `supreme_court_opinion_observations`

**Retained Supreme Court opinion observations**

One native opinion-row occurrence in a retained term-index render, including missing links, revisions and source page-start text.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained term-index renders and PDF probes. Repeated renders, missing links and revisions remain distinct; capture completion, redirects, PDF semantics and wider term coverage require separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `supreme_court_opinion_observations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity of this selected source observation. |
| `index_observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity joining this native opinion row to its exact index render. |
| `release_number` | `VARCHAR` | Literal release label, including decree labels. |
| `date_decided` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated decision date retained as text. |
| `docket_number` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source docket number. |
| `case_name` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated case name. |
| `holding` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source holding text. |
| `author_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source author code. |
| `citation` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated citation text. |
| `pdf_url` | `VARCHAR` | Literal selected-render PDF link; null if the row has no link. |
| `pdf_kind` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained classification of the linked PDF form. |
| `page_start` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated volume page start retained as text; no end page is inferred. |
| `revisions_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every native revision URI and literal revision label in source order. |
| `native_opinion_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete maintained native opinion row for this render occurrence. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Public URI identifying the selected source bytes. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original selected source bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `observation_time_state` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit state of the acquisition clock; unrecorded values stay unknown. |
| `term_year` | `BIGINT` | Term year validated against the retained index. |
| `opinion_index` | `BIGINT` | Native opinion-row position within its exact index render. |
